title: Playboy: Karaoke Collection Volume 1
native_title: プレイボーイ・カラオケ ＶＯＬ１
overview:
Enjoy sexy Playmate footage in the background while your karaoke improves by leaps and bounds!

Get ahead before the real performance - practice feature included

Playboy Karaoke Collection Volume 1 is karaoke software for adults. Each song plays as a music video starring Playboy models, with the lyrics on screen so you can sing along. Use the practice feature to polish a song before you take the mic for real.

- Six songs, including "I Love You", "True Love", "Good Night" and "Single Bed"
- Playmate video behind every song
- Practice feature
- For ages 18 and over
